title: Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
description:
Acme is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own our payments platform.

You will design and run Python and Go services that move money for two million customers, build reliable ledgers, and lead incident reviews.

Requirements: 6+ years of backend experience, PostgreSQL at scale, Kafka, and a habit of writing things down. Hybrid in Copenhagen.
